repaired_spec.source1:
Implement a 4-bit synchronous up counter.

- q increments by one on every rising edge of clk.
- reset is active-high and synchronous: when reset is 1, q is cleared to 0 on the next rising edge of clk.
- q saturates at 4'b1111 and does not wrap around.
repaired_spec.source2:
Implement a 4-bit synchronous up counter.

- q increments by one on every rising edge of clk.
- reset is active-low and asynchronous: when reset is 0, q is cleared to 0 immediately.
- q saturates at 4'b1111 and does not wrap around.
